description: File a bug report, feature request or question with the AnyForge team (the platform vendor), NOT with this workspace's own backlog (use anyforge_create_work_item for that). Use it when you find a problem with AnyForge itself while working through this connector. Send `publicTitle` and `publicSummary` written for the PUBLIC community board: no crew ids, repository names, people's names or other workspace details. Put everything else in `body` (private markdown, seen only by the AnyForge team) and `links`. Linked records you cannot access are left out and named in `skippedLinks`; the rest is still filed. Crew events and logs are attached only when `includeDiagnostics` is true. The answer lists exactly what was `sent` and which fields are `public`, and returns a tracking `code` and `url`. If the report matches an existing community request, nothing is filed and that request comes back as `duplicateOf`: pass `addToExisting: true` to add your evidence to it (and vote for it), or `fileAnyway: true` to file a new one. Private support requests (setup, access, data removal) are not filed here. Capped per key and per day.

addToExisting.description: When a match exists, add your evidence to it and vote for it instead of filing. Default false.

body.description: Private markdown for the AnyForge team: what happened, steps, expected result. Never shown on the board.

fileAnyway.description: File a new request even when a matching community request exists. Default false.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

includeDiagnostics.description: Attach the linked crew's recent events and logs. Default false.

links.description: Records the AnyForge team should look at. Each is checked against your workspace first.

publicSummary.description: Identity-free one or two sentence summary for the public board.

publicTitle.description: Identity-free title for the public community board.

type.description: bug, feature_request, or question about how AnyForge works.

name: anyforge_submit_feedback
title: Submit feedback
